notes: Mobile engage/peel support: Grand Entrance knockup and The Quickness charm start fights, Battle Dance dashes to shield allies. Best with Xayah and AoE follow-up (Yasuo, Orianna); struggles into Neeko, long-range Senna and dash-stoppers/disengage (Poppy, Janna).

Powerball gank-and-taunt tank jungler; Defensive Ball Curl punishes auto-attack divers (Rengar, Yi, Tryndamere). Weaker into kiting/early-duel junglers (Lillia, Rek'Sai, Trundle); wants magic-damage allies and follow-up for his engage.

Early tunnel ganker with Unburrow knockup and a long-range Void Rush execute; wants to snowball side lanes before tanks outscale. Beats Rammus, Kayn and Briar early but struggles into Sejuani and hard-CC tank junglers.

Hard-engage tank support: Crash Down knockup, Full Tilt stun and Magnet Storm pull make her a premier teamfight initiator. Pairs with AoE follow-up (Miss Fortune, Orianna, Samira); weak into drain/disengage supports (Swain, Janna, Neeko) and Poppy W.

Utility enchanter: Bailout revives aggressive carries and Hostile Takeover turns enemy dive/clumped teamfights on itself. Good vs Pyke and all-in lanes; bullied by long-range mage supports (Vel'Koz, Xerath) and Lulu.

Lane-bully bruiser with double dash and empowered W stun; wants to win lane and convert into early dives with his jungler. Falls off late and struggles into sustain/scaling tops (Dr. Mundo, Illaoi, Gangplank), Vayne and Teemo.
Bush-leaping one-shot assassin that snowballs picks on squishy carries and squishy junglers. Hard-countered by tanky taunt/CC junglers (Rammus, Sejuani) and Poppy W; needs an early lead to matter.

High-skill mobile skirmisher with animation-cancel burst and strong split-push; beats immobile bruisers/tanks (Sett, Sion, Yasuo, Gwen). Countered by ranged/stun tops (Kennen, Vayne) and sustain juggernauts (Illaoi, Singed).

Mech-mage teamfighter: Flamespitter wins trades vs melee and The Equalizer zones whole fights; a high-priority pro flex (top/jungle/mid) that wants CC to lock enemies in the ult. Struggles into Kayle, Gragas and Tahm Kench, and is a weak solo-queue blind.

Scaling battlemage with high sustained single-target DPS and Realm Warp for team flanks/escapes; a pro staple but a weak solo-queue lane. Needs time and items; bullied by mobile mids (Irelia, Qiyana, Zoe).

All-in hypercarry who builds Style to unleash Inferno Trigger; wants hard-engage supports (Nautilus, Leona, Rell, Rakan) and knockups. Wind Wall eats projectiles, but she is kited by long-range/drain mages (Swain, Veigar) and interrupts (Janna, Poppy).

Tank engage jungler with Glacial Prison and frost-stun passive; a reliable teamfight initiator and anti-dive frontline that loves melee-heavy allies. Beats snowball assassin junglers (Rengar, Rek'Sai, Kindred, Shaco); weak to kiting magic junglers (Lillia, Diana) and Trundle.

Scaling ranged support/carry: collects Mist for infinite range and AD, heals with Piercing Darkness and global-shields with Dawning Shadow. Wants long-range ADCs; vulnerable to point-and-click engage (Nautilus) and outranged by Xerath.

Scaling teamfight mage (support or bot) with long-range Encore charm engage, AoE shield/heal and solid waveclear. Needs frontline to cast behind; punished by dive/hook supports, Sivir's spell shield and Yasuo's Wind Wall.

Early/mid-game juggernaut with true-damage Haymaker and The Show Stopper suplex engage; bullies melee lanes and starts fights. Kited by ranged tops (Vayne, Ryze) and outplayed by Riven; falls off vs late-game scalers.

Invade-heavy trickster (AD jungle, occasionally AP support) with stealth, Jack in the Box fears and a clone; snowballs early and picks off carries. Falls off late; countered by tanky CC junglers (Sejuani) and strong early duelists.

Global-presence tank: Stand United shields and joins fights anywhere while he split-pushes; Shadow Dash taunt engages and Spirit's Refuge blocks autos. Good vs Fiora, Yorick and tanks; struggles into Quinn, Singed and extended-trade bruisers (Olaf, Sett, Tryndamere).

Reworked in 26.6: bruiser-tank dragon who farms Scalemail defensive stacks, then engages with the fear-leap Dragon's Descent and brawls with empowered abilities. Needs farm and time; hard-countered by Sylas (steals ult) and weak into Ivern and Udyr.

Proxy-farming split-pusher who drags enemies into chases with Poison Trail and flings targets into his team. Frustrates melee tops (Yasuo, Mordekaiser, Riven, Jax); weak into ranged/burst scalers (Gangplank, Kayle, Kennen).

Scaling HP-stacking tank with long-range Unstoppable Onslaught engage, Decimating Smash knockup and strong side-wave shove; a pro-play staple. Weak lane vs Riven, Yone, Shen and true-damage/ranged tops (Zaahen, Quinn, Gwen).

Waveclear/siege ADC with Spell Shield and team-wide On The Hunt speed; enables fast pushes, engages and disengages. Strong into mage/poke bots (Seraphine, Vel'Koz, Veigar); out-DPSed late by Kog'Maw and Twitch.

Tank jungler whose Impale suppresses and drags carries into his team, with Ixtal's Impact wall-stun charges for engage. Strong pick/anti-dive vs Nocturne, Graves and Sylas; weak to kiting and duelist junglers (Udyr, Gwen, Lillia).

Stack-scaling dragon ADC: quiet lane, then huge AoE waveclear and max-HP executes vs tanks at high stacks. Needs enchanter protection (Lulu, Milio) and time; long-range mage bots (Lux, Ziggs, Vel'Koz) and Twitch/Zeri out-trade him.

Scaling aura enchanter with heals, team speed and an AoE Crescendo stun; strong late-teamfight value. Fragile and immobile, so she needs a bot laner who can hold early pressure and frontline to protect her.

Premier sustain enchanter: Astral Infusion heals and global Wish negate poke and extend fights; Equinox silences. Great vs poke and all-in comps that can't burst through heals; countered by Grievous Wounds and out-traded by Senna and Nami.

Drain-tank battlemage (mostly support/bot, also mid/top) with Nevermove pull-root and Demonic Ascension sustain; wins brawls vs melee/all-in lanes (Rell, Leona, Nautilus, Samira). Kited by long-range mages and enchanters (Syndra, Zeri, Nami, Karma).

Skirmish mage (jungle or mid) who steals enemy ultimates; his value scales with the enemy's ults (hard-counters Malphite, Shyvana). Struggles into Taliyah, Gwen, Skarner, Pantheon and drain/anti-dash champions.

Burst/control mage (mid, also bot) with Scatter the Weak stun and point-and-click Unleashed Power execute; strong pick threat and lane control. Vulnerable to mobile assassins that dive past her stun (Fizz, Katarina, Locke).

Peel tank (support or top): Devour saves carries and grey-health bulk makes him a strong anti-assassin frontline. Beats melee/short-range tops (Irelia, Jayce, Rumble); weak to tanky scalers (Sion, Ornn, Singed) and Gwen's true damage.

Roaming waveclear mage (mid or jungle): Weaver's Wall splits fights and enables roams, Seismic Shove + Unraveled Earth punish dashers. Strong vs Yasuo/Sylas; weak to assassins (Zed, Katarina, Kassadin, LeBlanc) and long-range Xerath.
Roaming AD assassin with wall-hop parkour; snowballs early picks from jungle or mid and punishes squishy carries. Falls off late; weak vs Rengar, Fiddlesticks and mobile/CC mids (Ekko, Qiyana, Azir).

Protect/dive tank-enchanter: Cosmic Radiance invulnerability and linked Dazzle stuns enable all-ins and dives (Master Yi, Kai'Sa). Weak lane into ranged/poke and anti-engage supports (Senna, Milio, Morgana).

Ranged top that blinds auto-attackers (Vayne, Volibear, Renekton, Camille) and zones with Noxious Traps; split-pusher with poor teamfight. Countered by tanky engage and magic damage (Olaf, Sion, Ryze, Akali).

Pick-and-peel playmaker: Death Sentence hooks and Flay engage, while Dark Passage lantern saves or repositions allies. Fits almost any comp; best with Kalista/Draven. Mage supports (Brand) and spell shields blunt his hooks.

Scaling siege ADC with Rocket Jump resets, tower-shredding Explosive Charge and self-peel Buster Shot; all-in capable with engage supports. Strong into immobile mage bots (Vel'Koz, Xerath); struggles vs Nilah and drain/burst mages (Karthus, Veigar, Vladimir).
